title: On the generalized Turán number of the complete bipartite graph $K_{3,b+1}$
summary: For graphs $F$ and $H$, let $\mathrm{ex}(n,H,F)$ denote the maximum number of copies of $H$ in an $n$-vertex $F$-free graph. Very recently, Janzer, Longbrake, and Yepremyan proved that for $3<a\leq b$ and sufficiently large $t$, \begin{equation*} \mathrm{ex}(n,K_{a,b},K_{3,t})=Θ_{a,b,t}(n^3). \end{equation*} Later, Hou, Hu, and Wang made this threshold explicit by showing that the conclusion holds for all $t\geq 2\max\{3,\lceil b/2\rceil\}+1$. In particular, for every even $b\geq 6$, this matches the necessary threshold $t=b+1$. In this paper, we resolve the remaining case where $b$ is odd.…
